card.name: Verbs after a document or authority
card.fires_on: The verb right after a text or authority used as subject, such as the Bible, the law, the requirements or a label. It is often a stating verb like clear, call, says, states or prohibit.

modes.description: The Bible or Testament is followed by a verb or adjective about what it states.
